[Documentation](../../docs.html) / [Question types](../../docs.html#question-types)

Add a question and choose Short text for a word or a line.

![The a short text answer question selected in the editor, its settings outlined.](../../../docs/question-types/short-text-editor.png){width=100%}

## What the respondent sees

![The question as the respondent sees it.](../../../docs/question-types/short-text-preview.png){width=90%}

## Settings

- **Required.** Asks for an answer before the respondent goes on. Leave open questions optional where you can.

## Best practices for research

Ask for a short text only where the answer cannot be listed: open answers take longer and are skipped more.

Reference: Dillman, D. A., Smyth, J. D., & Christian, L. M. (2014). *Internet, phone, mail, and mixed-mode surveys: The tailored design method* (4th ed.). Wiley.
